_comment: Hand-authored function/cost/datasheet lookup keyed by MPN. Merged into each BomLine at load time. Unit costs are USD at single-unit Digi-Key pricing unless noted.

SC0915.function: The MCU. Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040 @ 133 MHz, 264 KB SRAM, 2 MB onboard flash). Runs the libros firmware. This is the original Pico (SC0915), the non-wireless board the firmware's `board = pico` setting names.
SC0915.notes: The Pico W (SC0918) adds a radio and is a future option only: its fit with this firmware is not established. The Pico 2 uses an RP2350 and would need its own firmware port. Digi-Key part number for SC0915 is not recorded here; add it from the Digi-Key listing.

OSO-BOOK-C2-01.function: Castellated e-paper driver submodule. Generates the ±22 V and ±15 V rails the e-paper panel needs, converts signal levels between the Pico and the display, and drives the FFC ribbon. Ordered pre-assembled from JLCPCB or PCBWay; soldered to the C1 main board via castellated edge pads.
OSO-BOOK-C2-01.notes: Separate PCBA job with no quote yet, so the C1 totals leave it out. The chosen route is the C2-03 package (JLCPCB: BOM, placement file and Gerbers from one folder). The board viewer shows C2-02 data. C2-02 and C2-03 list the same parts and the same nets; C2-03 moves every element by 0.254 mm in x and 5.08 mm in y and uses a 0402 R1 where C2-02 has 0603. Copper was not compared. Both packages carry the 10 µH and 0.47 Ω values; see the GDEY042T81 note.

MEM2075-00-140-01-A.function: Push/push microSD card slot. Holds the book library on a microSD card — UTF-8 .txt files with support for bold, italic, chapter breaks, and front-matter metadata via inline control codes.

GD25Q16CTIGR.function: 16 Mb SPI NOR flash. Stores the GNU Unifont + per-language glyph data that doesn't fit in the Pico's 2 MB flash. Read over the shared SPI bus via /BABEL_CS.
GD25Q16CTIGR.notes: The pin-compatible MX25L1606E also works in this footprint.

DMG3415U-7.function: P-channel MOSFET, two on the board. Q1 sits in the battery power path (gate VBUS, source VCC, drain +BATT). Q2 switches the +3.3VP rail: gate /~{EN2} (Pico GPIO0), source +3V3, drain +3.3VP. That rail powers the C2 module and the chip-select pull-ups.

CL31B106KQHNFNE.function: 10 µF MLCC, 1206, ≥6.3 V. Bulk decoupling on the battery rail (+BATT) and the switched 3.3 V rail (+3.3VP).

CL21B105KAFNNNE.function: 1 µF MLCC, 0805, ≥6.3 V. Local decoupling on the 3V3 rail.

RMCF1206JT10K0.function: 10 kΩ, 1206. R3 pulls the flash chip select (/BABEL_CS) up to +3.3VP. R4 does the same for the microSD chip select (/SD_CS).

RC0805JR-071KL.function: 1 kΩ, 0805. OPTIONAL. R1 and R2 are series resistors between the Pico's GP26 and GP27 and the expansion connector signals. Fit them only if the expansion ports are used.
RC0805JR-071KL.notes: Marked OPTIONAL in 1-click-bom.csv (R1, R2). Series resistors, not I²C pull-ups (checked against the board's nets).

434351045816.function: Right-angle SMD tactile button (Würth), one on each side of the board. One is wired to /RESET and the other to /BTN_LOCK, so they are Reset and Lock. Page turning uses the seven front buttons.

JS102011SAQN.function: Right-angle SMD slide switch (C&K, SPDT). Power on/off slide switch on the device side.

TL1107AF180WQ.function: 3 × 6 mm through-hole tactile button (E-Switch). The menu / directional / select cluster under the screen. 7 placements (B3–B9). The BOM specifies the 180WQ (1.8 N, firmer click); the upstream README links to the 130WQ (1.3 N, lighter touch). Either fits the same footprint — order whichever feel you prefer.

S3B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN).function: 3-pin JST PH SMD connector (STEMMA style), J1 and J2. OPTIONAL expansion. Each carries one GPIO signal, +3V3 and GND.

BM04B-SRSS-TB(LF)(SN).function: 4-pin JST SH SMD connector (STEMMA QT style), J3. OPTIONAL expansion. Pins are RX/SCL, TX/SDA, +3V3 and GND, so it can serve as an I²C port.

1022.function: Dual AAA battery holder (Keystone). SMD-mounted; the 1022C retainer clip is required separately to keep cells in place.

1022C.function: Retainer clip for the Keystone 1022 battery holder. Snaps over installed AAA cells.
1022C.notes: Added to the BOM on 2026-11-17: the retainer was missing from the C1 BOM although the assembly step called for it.

0603WAJ047KT5E.function: 0.47 Ω sense resistor, 0603. Current-sense feedback for the boost converter that generates the e-paper high-voltage rails.
0603WAJ047KT5E.notes: LCSC C270932 (supersedes dead C23703). UNI-ROYAL (Uniroyal Elec). Also on Mouser as Royalohm 0603WAJ047KT5E.

MGFL2012F100MT-LF.function: 10 µH inductor, 0805, 500 mA. Energy storage for the boost converter.

CL21B105KBFNNNE.function: 1 µF MLCC, 0805, 50 V, X7R. Bypass and filter capacitors throughout the driver circuit (9 placements).

CL21A475KAQNNNE.function: 4.7 µF MLCC, 0805, 25 V, X5R. Bulk decoupling on the driver power rails.

AFC07-S24ECC-00.function: 24-pin 0.5 mm FFC connector. Connects the flat flex cable from the e-paper display panel.

IRLML0100TRPBF.function: N-channel MOSFET, 100 V, 1.6 A, SOT-23. Switches the e-paper gate driver voltage rail.

LMBR0530T1G.function: 30 V Schottky diode, SOD-123. Charge-pump rectifiers for the negative voltage rails (3 placements).

GDEY042T81.function: 4.2-inch B&W e-paper panel (Good Display), 400 × 300 px, SSD1683 controller, 24-pin FFC to the C2 driver module. Unvalidated in this design: see the notes. Order the black and white model, not the tri-colour one.
GDEY042T81.notes: Replaces the end-of-life GDEW042T2 (UC8176/IL0398), which Good Display confirmed EOL in 2023; the prebuilt book.uf2 targets that older controller only. Open questions, none settled by a pilot: (1) the creator said in November 2023 (The-Open-Book issue #77) that this panel might need a larger C2 inductor, a signal pulldown and possibly a different current-sense resistor; (2) Good Display's reference circuit shows 47 µH, 2.2 Ω and a 1 MΩ pulldown, while the C2-02 and C2-03 BOMs list 10 µH and 0.47 Ω with no pulldown; (3) firmware support needs libros PR #11, which was unmerged on 2026-11-15; (4) two Good Display storefront listings showed zero stock on 2026-11-15, and no ten-panel source is confirmed. Values check, 2026-11-17 (docs/gdey-c2-values-check.md): the C2-03 circuit has the same topology as Good Display's reference but no GDR pulldown and no footprint for one, a 10 µH inductor in an 0805 footprint where the reference shows 47 µH at 500 mA, a 0.47 Ω sense resistor where the reference shows 2.2 Ω, and a 1 µF input capacitor where the reference shows 4.7 µF. The public reports do not show anyone running this exact combination.
